name: org.jooq:jooq
scope: One SQL statement from local bytes decoded as strict UTF-8; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls, each equal to the hand-written oracle summary. Commercial-edition dialects and dialect-specific parsing are untested.
family: jOOQ hand-written recursive-descent parser (ParserImpl) and query object model
family_note: Parser.parse runs org.jooq.impl.ParserImpl, which builds jOOQ's query object model. The adapter reads Select $select/$from/$where/$groupBy/$orderBy and QOM.Insert $into/$columns/$values, and walks QOM.Join, QOM.TableAlias, QOM.FieldAlias, QOM.Count/Sum and Param values, using each operator's $args() for conditions. Independent of JSqlParser (JavaCC), Calcite (JavaCC), Druid and the Presto/Trino ANTLR grammars.

popularity.metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over every Maven release
popularity.limitation: Dependents mostly use jOOQ's query builder and execution layer, not its SQL parser; a dependent is counted once per release it depends on.

name: com.alibaba:druid
scope: One SQL statement from local bytes decoded as strict UTF-8; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls, each equal to the hand-written oracle summary. Other DbType grammars are untested.
family: Druid hand-written SQL lexer and recursive-descent parsers
family_note: SQLUtils.parseStatements creates the MySQL statement parser (MySqlStatementParser, MySqlSelectParser, MySqlExprParser over the shared SQLStatementParser, SQLSelectParser, SQLExprParser and Lexer) and returns Druid SQL AST nodes. The adapter reads SQLSelectQueryBlock and SQLInsertStatement fields and collects tables, aggregate/method names and char/integer/number literals with an SQLASTVisitorAdapter. Independent of jOOQ, JSqlParser, Calcite and the Presto/Trino ANTLR grammars.

popularity.metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over every Maven release
popularity.limitation: Most dependents use Druid's JDBC connection pool, which ships in the same artifact as the SQL parser.

name: com.facebook.presto:presto-parser
input_api: SqlParser.createStatement(statement text from StatementSplitter over local SQL text, ParsingOptions with DecimalLiteralTreatment.AS_DECIMAL) -> Statement
dialect: Presto SQL (the only grammar; ParsingOptions DecimalLiteralTreatment.AS_DECIMAL so 19.5 is a DecimalLiteral)
scope: One SQL statement from local bytes decoded as strict UTF-8, split by StatementSplitter; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls, each equal to the hand-written oracle summary. Other ParsingOptions and Presto-only syntax are untested.
family_note: SqlParser.createStatement runs the ANTLR4-generated SqlBaseLexer and SqlBaseParser from Presto's SqlBase.g4 and converts the parse tree with the hand-written AstBuilder into com.facebook.presto.sql.tree nodes. The adapter splits with the public StatementSplitter (which strips the terminating semicolon), reads Query/QuerySpecification and Insert/Values fields and collects Table, FunctionCall, StringLiteral, LongLiteral and DecimalLiteral nodes with a DefaultTraversalVisitor. io.trino:trino-parser and io.prestosql:presto-parser descend from the same SqlBase grammar and AstBuilder (shared family, distinct package APIs and diverged sources). Independent of jOOQ, Druid, Calcite and JSqlParser.

popularity.metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over every Maven release
popularity.limitation: Summed over 307 releases, so long-lived dependents count once per release; the newest release alone has far fewer direct dependents.

name: org.apache.calcite:calcite-core
dialect: SqlParser.config() default (Calcite default lexical policy and SqlConformanceEnum.DEFAULT)
scope: One SQL statement from local bytes decoded as strict UTF-8; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls, each equal to the hand-written oracle summary. Other lexical policies, conformance levels and the Babel and server parsers are untested.
family_note: SqlParser.parseStmtList runs the JavaCC-generated SqlParserImpl (from Calcite's Parser.jj template) and returns SqlNode trees: SqlOrderBy wrapping SqlSelect for the query and SqlInsert with a VALUES call for the insert. The adapter reads those fields, walks SqlJoin and AS calls in the FROM clause for base tables, and collects SqlFunction calls and SqlCharStringLiteral/SqlNumericLiteral values with an SqlBasicVisitor. Unquoted identifiers are upper-cased by the default lexical policy; the adapter lower-cases them. Independent of jOOQ, Druid, JSqlParser and the Presto/Trino ANTLR grammars.

popularity.metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over every Maven release
popularity.limitation: Summed over 45 releases; most calcite-core dependents use its planner, adapters or JDBC driver, not only the SQL parser.

name: org.apache.hive:hive-exec
license_evidence: Apache-2.0 (hive-4.2.1.pom inherits org.apache:apache:23, Apache License, Version 2.0; META-INF/LICENSE in the jar)
input_api: new ParseDriver().parse(local SQL text without its terminating semicolon).getTree() -> ASTNode
dialect: HiveQL (ParseDriver.parse without a Configuration: default lexer, standard quoted-identifier handling)
scope: One SQL statement from local bytes decoded as strict UTF-8, with one terminating semicolon removed by the adapter; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls, each equal to the hand-written oracle summary. statement_count is 1 by the single-statement parse contract; INSERT rows are the struct calls of Hive's inline(array(...)) VALUES rewrite. Configuration-dependent lexing and HiveQL-only syntax are untested.
family_note: ParseDriver.parse lexes with HiveLexer and parses with the ANTLR 3.5.2-generated HiveParser (which imports the FromClause, SelectClause, Identifiers and other sub-grammars) and returns an ASTNode tree of TOK_* imaginary tokens. The parser classes ship inside the hive-exec uber jar (from the hive-parser module); the hive-parser sources jar has the grammars but not the generated Java, so the image regenerates it with ANTLR 3.5.2 and checks every generated class's line table against the class in hive-exec. Parsing needs hadoop-common's Configuration class and --add-opens java.base/java.net (HiveConf static initialisation); five more jars are pinned for that. Independent of jOOQ, Druid, Calcite, JSqlParser and the Presto/Trino and Spark grammars.

popularity.metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over every Maven release
popularity.limitation: Summed over hive-exec releases; hive-exec is Hive's whole execution engine, so most dependents use more than the parser. The standalone hive-parser module has 0 direct dependents.

name: com.github.jsqlparser:jsqlparser
license_evidence: LGPL-2.1 or Apache-2.0 (jsqlparser-5.4.pom lists GNU Library or Lesser General Public License (LGPL) V2.1 and The Apache Software License, Version 2.0)
dialect: JSqlParser default parser features (no dialect switch; CCJSqlParserUtil.parseStatements without a parser consumer)
scope: One SQL statement from local bytes decoded as strict UTF-8; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls, each equal to the hand-written oracle summary. Non-default parser features and vendor syntax are untested.
family_note: CCJSqlParserUtil.parseStatements runs the JavaCC-generated CCJSqlParser (first without, then if needed with complex parsing, on a single-thread executor) and returns net.sf.jsqlparser Statement objects: PlainSelect for the query and Insert with a Values select for the insert. The adapter reads those fields and subclasses the library's TablesNamesFinder to collect base tables, Function names and StringValue/LongValue/DoubleValue values. net.sf.jsqlparser:jsqlparser 0.7.0 is the ancient coordinate of the same project (excluded). Independent of jOOQ, Druid, Calcite and the Presto/Trino ANTLR grammars.

popularity.metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over every Maven release
popularity.limitation: Summed over 37 releases of the com.github.jsqlparser coordinate; the older net.sf.jsqlparser coordinate (8) is not added.

name: io.trino:trino-parser
input_api: new SqlParser().createStatement(local SQL text without its terminating semicolon) -> Statement
dialect: Trino SQL (the only grammar; no parsing options)
scope: One SQL statement from local bytes decoded as strict UTF-8, with one terminating semicolon removed by the adapter; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls, each equal to the hand-written oracle summary. statement_count is 1 by the single-statement API contract. Trino-only syntax is untested.
family_note: SqlParser.createStatement runs the ANTLR4-generated SqlBaseLexer and SqlBaseParser shipped in io.trino:trino-grammar and converts the parse tree with trino-parser's AstBuilder into io.trino.sql.tree nodes. Trino forked from Presto in 2019 (PrestoSQL, renamed Trino in 2020); its SqlBase.g4 and AstBuilder descend from the same sources as com.facebook.presto:presto-parser but have diverged (separate grammar module, different node APIs such as LongLiteral.getValue returning source text). The adapter strips one terminating semicolon because the grammar's singleStatement rule takes no terminator and trino-parser has no public splitter (the CLI's StatementSplitter is in trino-cli). Independent of jOOQ, Druid, Calcite and JSqlParser.

popularity.metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over every Maven release
popularity.limitation: Summed over 132 releases; the newest releases have few direct dependents.
